from toyapp.auth import Request, Response, auth_middleware, TOKEN_TO_USER

def dummy(req):
    return Response(200, "ok for " + str(req.user_id))

def probe(name, headers, path="/api/items"):
    req = Request(headers, path)
    r = auth_middleware(req, dummy)
    print("%-48s -> %s  user_id=%r" % (name, r.status_code, req.user_id))

probe("1. valid Bearer dev-token",        {"Authorization": "Bearer dev-token"})
probe("2. scheme-less dev-token",          {"Authorization": "dev-token"})
probe("3. lowercase bearer dev-token",     {"Authorization": "bearer dev-token"})
probe("4. UPPERCASE BEARER dev-token",     {"Authorization": "BEARER dev-token"})
probe("5. X-Debug-User backdoor alone",    {"X-Debug-User": "admin"})
probe("6. X-Debug-User + bogus token",     {"Authorization": "Bearer nope", "X-Debug-User": "bob"})
probe("7. /health bypass (exact)",         {}, "/health")
probe("8. /health-subpath collision",      {}, "/health-events")
probe("9. /health then traversal",         {}, "/health/../api/admin")
probe("10. lowercase x-debug-user",        {"x-debug-user": "mallory"})
probe("11. lowercase authorization",       {"authorization": "Bearer dev-token"})
probe("12. no auth at all",                {}, "/api/items")
probe("13. empty-string token",            {"Authorization": "Bearer "}, "/api/items")
print("tokens:", TOKEN_TO_USER)
